title: Conditional 6D-to-4D baryogenesis source bridge audit
assumptions: one physical time and positive-signature compact internal two-space
a scalar candidate mode Theta(x,y)=f0(y)q(x)+heavy modes
brane-localized derivative current coupling suppressed by M_b^2
radiation domination at electroweak sphaleron freeze-out
the required epsilon_Theta is imported from the 0.4 Standard Model transport benchmark
isocurvature uses the editable response ansatz d ln eta_B/d phi_*=kappa_iso/f_eff

equations.zero_mode_norm: Z0=integral d2y sqrt(g2) e^(2A) Z6 f0^2 > 0
equations.source_scaling: epsilon_Theta proportional T^m implies ddot(phi)=-(m+1)H dot(phi)

interpretation.natural_benchmark: gravity matching can be near the observed reduced Planck scale while the derivative source requires catastrophic kinetic backreaction if M_b=M6 and xi=1
interpretation.tension: under the illustrative kappa_iso/f_eff response and H_*=1e8 GeV, the isocurvature lower bound lies above the backreaction upper bound
interpretation.not_a_no_go: the tension is conditional and can change with a different source operator, localized wavefunction, lower inflationary scale, noncanonical dynamics, transient production, or a fully coupled current backreaction

limitations: no explicit S6-Q1 background solution or zero-mode eigenfunction is inserted
the overlap xi and brane scale M_b are not derived from a parent action
warping, caps and deficit angles are compressed into one volume factor
the Theta potential and coupled equation of motion are not solved
current backreaction and entropy production are omitted
the isocurvature response coefficient is a transparent benchmark assumption rather than a derived transfer function
the 0.5 result has no evidence effect and does not release K1-D or K1-E
